description: True positive recall: both Bloom and Ribbon filters achieve 100% recall with zero false negatives on existing keys
False positive rate benchmark: querying 500 absent keys validates sub-1.5% FPR for both filters
Memory efficiency at scale: Ribbon filter delivers 20.76% memory savings compared to 10-bit Bloom filter
Narrow ribbon band evaluation: w=16 band maintains solver consistency and achieves over 15% space reduction
Compact signature scaling: r=5 target bits yields predictable 3.125% theoretical FPR with ultra-compact storage
Ultra-low false positive regime: r=10 bits achieves 0.0% empirical FPR on 400 negative queries
Aggressive slot ratio optimization: 1.05 packing pushes memory savings above 21% without degradation
Comprehensive enterprise SSTable audit: 1200 production keys with mixed lookups proving 22.5% DRAM savings and equivalent FPR
